series.name: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)
series.notes: IMPORTANT SCOPING FINDING: the MultiPlus Compact has only THREE front LEDs (inverter, charger, alarm) and its manual contains NO VE.Bus 0-26 error code table and NO VE.Bus OK codes. The fault identification method is the numbered 'pre-alarm alternative 1-5' list in ch. 7 Troubleshooting. Do NOT cross-apply the MultiPlus 8-LED VE.Bus codes to a MultiPlus Compact - the LED hardware is physically different. Manual used: 12/2000/80-35 and 24/2000/50-50 230 V. The sibling manuals for 800/1200/1600 VA and the 120 V 2000 VA version carry the same pre-alarm 1-5 list.

aliases: Alarm LED flashes - DC input voltage low

title.ur: Pre-alarm 1 - DC input voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The alarm LED is flashing because the DC input voltage is low. The inverter is warning before shutting down.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED is liye flash kar raha hai kyunke DC input voltage kam hai. Inverter band hone se pehle warn kar raha hai.

causes.ur: Battery bank khatam ho chuka hai

causes.en: Poor battery connection causing a voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery connection kharab jo voltage drop kar raha hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter terminals with the unit under load.
solutions.ur: Unit load ke halat mein apne terminals par battery voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery, then re-check the terminals for tightness and corrosion.
solutions.ur: Battery charge karein, phir terminals ki tightness aur corrosion dobara check karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

aliases: Alarm LED flashes - ambient too hot

title.ur: Pre-alarm 2 - ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: The alarm LED is flashing because the ambient temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED is liye flash kar raha hai kyunke ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Unit installed in a hot, poorly ventilated room
causes.ur: Unit garam aur kam hawa wale kamre mein laga hua hai

causes.en: Load too high for the unit's thermal design
causes.ur: Load unit ke thermal design ke liye zyada hai

solutions.en: Move the inverter to a cool, well-ventilated room with at least 10 cm clearance around it.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko thande, hawa wale kamre mein le jayein jahan charon taraf 10 cm khali ho.

solutions.en: Never mount the unit directly above the batteries - move it away from them.
solutions.ur: Unit ko kabhi batteries ke bilkul upar na lagayein - use batteries se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load so it generates less internal heat.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein taake andar kam garmi paida ho.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

title.ur: Pre-alarm 3 - load nominal se upar hai

meaning.en: The alarm LED is flashing because the connected load exceeds the inverter's nominal load.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED is liye flash kar raha hai kyunke connected load inverter ke nominal load se zyada hai.

causes.en: Load connected above the inverter's nominal rating
causes.ur: Inverter ke nominal rating se upar load juri hui hai

causes.en: Several large appliances switched on together
causes.ur: Kai bhaari bartan aik saath on kar diye gaye

solutions.en: Measure the load current with a clamp meter and compare to the nameplate rating.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load current nikaal kar nameplate rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load until the alarm LED stops flashing.
solutions.ur: Load itna kam karein jab tak alarm LED band na ho jaye.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

aliases: Alarm LED flashes - DC ripple high

title.ur: Pre-alarm 4 - DC ripple 1.25 Vrms se upar hai

meaning.en: Voltage ripple on the DC input exceeds 1.25 Vrms, so the battery cable run is too thin, too long or resistive.
meaning.ur: DC input par voltage ripple 1.25 Vrms se zyada hai, is liye battery cable bahut patli, lambi ya resistance wala hai.

causes.en: Battery cable too thin or too long for the current
causes.ur: Battery cable current ke liye bahut patli ya lambi hai

causes.en: Corroded or loose terminals adding resistance
causes.ur: Corrode ya dheele terminals jo resistance barha rahe hain

causes.en: Battery capacity too small for the load
causes.ur: Battery capacity load ke liye bahut kam hai

solutions.en: Check the battery cables and terminals; clean and re-tighten every connection.
solutions.ur: Battery cables aur terminals check karein; har connection saaf karke dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC ripple with a true RMS meter; it must stay below 1.25 Vrms.
solutions.ur: True RMS meter se DC ripple nikaalein; ye 1.25 Vrms se neeche rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Check whether battery capacity is sufficient and increase it if necessary.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery capacity kaafi hai aur zaroorat ho to barha dein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

title.en: Pre-alarm 5 - low battery plus excessive load
title.ur: Pre-alarm 5 - low battery aur bohat zyada load

meaning.en: The alarm LED flashes intermittently because low battery voltage and excessive load are occurring together.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED baari baari flash karta hai kyunke low battery voltage aur bohat zyada load aik saath aa rahe hain.

causes.en: Battery voltage low while a heavy load is running
causes.ur: Battery voltage kam hai jab bhaari load chal raha hai

causes.en: Bank capacity or cable gauge insufficient for the load
causes.ur: Bank capacity ya cable gauge load ke liye kaafi nahi

solutions.en: Charge the batteries before investigating anything else.
solutions.ur: Baqi sab dekhne se pehle batteries charge karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load, or install batteries with a higher capacity.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein, ya bade capacity ki batteries lagayein.

solutions.en: Use shorter and/or thicker battery cables.
solutions.ur: Chhoti aur/or moti battery cables istemal karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

title.en: Alarm LED lit - inverter cut out after a pre-alarm
title.ur: Alarm LED on - pre-alarm ke baad inverter cut out

meaning.en: The inverter did cut out following one of the pre-alarms above. The lit alarm LED means the shutdown has already happened.
meaning.ur: Inverter upar wale kisi pre-alarm ke baad sach mein cut out ho gaya. Alarm LED ka on hona matlab band hone ki amal d ho chuki hai.

causes.en: Any of pre-alarm 1-5 was allowed to continue until shutdown
causes.ur: Pre-alarm 1 se 5 mein se koi aik chalte rehne diya gaya aur band ho gaya

causes.en: Underlying cause not removed between restarts
causes.ur: Dobara on karne ke darmiyan asal wajah hatayi nahi gayi

solutions.en: Look up the matching pre-alarm 1-5 row and fix that specific cause first.
solutions.ur: Pehle us pre-alarm 1 se 5 ki row dekhein jis wajah se ye hua, wohi masla theek karein.

solutions.en: Per the manual: disconnect DC loads from the batteries and AC loads from the inverter before testing.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq: test karne se pehle batteries se DC loads aur inverter se AC loads disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Only then reset the unit by switching the front rocker off, waiting 4 s, and on again.
solutions.ur: Uske baad front rocker off karke 4 second intezaar karein aur on karke unit reset karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table
